title: K.C. Gajapati Narayan Deo v. State of Orissa

content.caseIdentity: K.C. Gajapati Narayan Deo v. State of Orissa, AIR 1953 SC 375
content.holding: The doctrine of colourable legislation resolves itself exclusively into the question of legislative competence; legislative motives, bona fides, and mala fides are completely irrelevant.
content.relevance: Locus classicus establishing that competence, not motive, governs colourability.
